newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jobless rate falls in May, lowest in 23 years.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jobless rate falls in May, lowest in 23 years.

text.p: The U.S. unemployment rate fell in May to its lowest level in more than 23 years, but jobs growth slowed sharply, the government said on Friday in a report that painted a mixed picture of the labor market.

The Labor Department said the unemployment rate edged down to 4.8 percent in May -- its lowest level since October 1973 -- from 4.9 percent in April. But payrolls rose by just 138,000 last month after increasing by a whopping 323,000 in April.
